name: Melink Solar
description: Since 1987, Melink Solar has been helping organizations of all sizes create a sustainable future. We became a leader in renewable energy when we built one of the nation’s first LEED Platinum-certified buildings, demonstrating the business case for clean energy. In 2008, we launched our solar division and have since installed over 275 MW across the U.S. Our experience spans projects of all scales, from small commercial installations to large utility-scale arrays, always delivering tailored solutions to meet each customer’s unique needs. Known for our expertise and commitment to quality, we’re proud that so many of our clients return to work with us on future projects. Whether it’s a first-time installation or part of a long-term energy strategy, we’re here to guide you toward a more sustainable future.
